body.message:
We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused. We have received an update from the owner that the viewing is required this week, rather than next week.

Would it be possible for you to accommodate the viewing on any convenient day this week, preferably around 5:00 PM? Please let us know which date works best for you, and we will coordinate everything with the owner accordingly.

We truly appreciate your patience, understanding, and kind cooperation, and once again, we sincerely apologize for the confusion.
